why: A flat terrain standing on `datum/nowhere`, which the plan declares no `datums[]` entry for. The terrain's walk plane IS that datum — its surface block stands one under it — so a terrain on a plane nothing declares has no height at all, and the reference is refused as every dangling reference is, `DW0112`. This is where the `flat` terrain is written: the gallery's `open` point carries a heightmap, its `solid` point no terrain, so the flat form is refusal-proven here and built green on the engine's own blockout fixture.
